title: Classifier spend counts toward a run's cost budget
description: Triaged 2026-09-23 from wne's close-out (finding c74c4fda). The budget acts on the AI Gateway's logs, and the Jev route bypasses the gateway, so a run's cost_usd understates by its classification spend (~$0.001 per tick, recorded per call in the decision record's usage field). Either have the budget add the recorded classification usage, or document the ceiling and why it is acceptable.
acceptance_criteria: A run's reported cost includes its recorded classification spend, or the budget's documentation states the exclusion and its bound
